text:
anya: Heads-up  locking the rollout play for embeddings-route.v1. This is customer-driven (search relevance customers). Need regional slices, per-tenant opt-ins, and an explicit safety latch.
kevin: Can we avoid full region spikes? I'd like region+zone weighted ramps and a default shadow mode for 24h.
marcus: Safety-latch idea: two-tier kill conditions. Soft-latch: pause auto-ramp if health_delta > 10 points. Hard-latch: immediate rollback if error_rate > 1% or any data-loss event.
violet: For A/B we'll run relevance_score lift + downstream CTR. Block >15% unless lift is non-negative and CI narrow.
sam: Sales asks for VIP customers to be in Tier-0 opt-in. We'll need per-tenant override and audit log for enable/disable.
anya: Agreed: default = shadow, opt-in via tenant flag, tiered cohorts (tier0, tier1, general). Add console toggle and API.
kevin: Feature-flag strategy example (pseudocode): `flag: embeddings-route.v1`, strategies: [{region: eu-west-1, pct:1}, {tenant: T-VIP-77, pct:100}], latch: {soft:10, hard:{err_pct:1}}.
marcus: Ops windows: request two 90m watch slots next week (09:30-11:00 PT, 15:00-16:30 PT). Ensure oncall + infra lead listed.
violet: Experiment runs: 7 days at 15% for non-critical flows; tag telemetry with experiment_id and cohort. Create dashboard with uplift, CTR, latency p95.
sam: Manual "pause" button in admin console + automated email to customer ops on actions. Security review required for audit trail.
anya: Gate for stage 2 (regional warmup): no hard-latch triggers, soft-latch within tolerance for 60m, no customer complaints, and experiment lift >=0.
kevin: Fallback: route back to embeddings-route.v0 and mark flag state `paused` with reason. Prevent auto-reenable for 12h.
marcus: Automations: webhook to #incidents when latch fires, auto-rollover to fallback, create postmortem skeleton if rollback occurs.
violet: I'll instrument the dashboard and wire the CI gate to block >15% if sample size insufficient.
sam: I'll deliver VIP tenant CSV and confirm any contractual windows.
deploy-bot: Note: soft/hard latch hooks available. Will post triggers to channel and escalate per runbook. :gear: 
anya: Next steps: I'll author RB-2026-215, kevin opens flag PR, marcus configures automations, violet wires metrics, sam delivers CSV. Target shadow start Thu 07:00 PT.
kevin: PR by EOD tomorrow.
marcus: Ops slots booked.
anya: Posting as canonical plan. Ping me in-thread for any changes. :white_check_mark:
